test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.**

Capable of or adapted for turning easily from one to another of various tasks, fields of endeavour, etc. and is able to do many things.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Versatile**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Versatile **means capable of or adapted for turning easily from one to another of various tasks, fields of endeavour, etc. and is able to do many things. (विभिन्न कार्यों, प्रयास के क्षेत्रों आदि को एक से दूसरे में आसानी से बदलने में सक्षम या अनुकूलित और कई काम करने में सक्षम है)
 
• The word is derived from the Latin word '**versatilis**' which means "**turning around**".
 
 
• **For example-** *She is a versatile actress who can perform in both comedy and drama roles.*
 
 
 
• So, It is the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Turncoat **means a person who deserts one party or causes in order to join an opposing one. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी विरोधी पार्टी में शामिल होने के लिए किसी पार्टी या कारण को छोड़ देता है)
 
• **Talented **means having a natural aptitude or skill for something. (किसी चीज़ के लिए स्वाभाविक योग्यता या कौशल होना)
 
• **Flexible **means capable of bending easily without breaking. (बिना टूटे आसानी से झुकने में सक्षम)
